title: Security Incident at Kashi Vishwanath Temple in India
summary: A shooting incident occurred at the Kashi Vishwanath temple in Varanasi, India, where three people were injured. The incident involved a security personnel's rifle firing, which was accidental and resulted in the injury of three individuals. An investigation into the incident has been launched by security agencies.
summary_points: A shooting incident occurred at the Kashi Vishwanath temple in Varanasi, India.
Three people were injured in the incident.
The incident involved a security personnel's rifle firing, which was accidental.
An investigation into the incident has been launched by security agencies.
The incident highlights concerns about security and safety measures at public places.
